name: jaguar_saw
character: A jaguar: a run of low sawing coughs, then one or two grunts. The roughness is noise and a subharmonic, not a chopped pulse.
sources: No reliable measured jaguar fundamental was found; a related cat (puma) is 291-438 Hz, mean call 0.65 s: https://www.uv.mx/personal/pdias/files/2025/10/Rangel-Negrinetal.2025.pdf
Longer, heavier vocal folds give a lower fundamental (big-cat roar physics): https://physicstoday.aip.org/quick-study/what-makes-a-big-cat-roar
ESTIMATE: f0 70-150 Hz, lengths and pulse rate are not measured and not auditioned; replace with a recording's numbers
Taylor and Reby (2010), J. Zoology 280: source-filter theory for mammal calls
